text.content:
Old Tam's journal, waterlogged and wool-stuffed, recovered from beneath a collapsed shelf near the Entrance. Most of it is mundane herd-keeping - lambing dates, trade routes, a running complaint about the weather - but the final pages turn urgent: he describes digging a "hook that isn't a hook" out of the yard wall, golden and wrong-shaped, and the strange, gentle pull it exerted on anyone who got too close to it. He never removed it from the yard. Instead he wrote out, and apparently sang, an old counting-rhyme at it every night - by his own account, enough to keep it quiet for the rest of his life. The journal ends without explaining why he stopped.

This is leverage against whatever the Wool-Crowned King has become - the goblins have no idea the object at the center of their throne room has a known, mundane countermeasure, because none of them have ever thought of it as dangerous in the first place.

Located in: Entrance (Room 0). Payoff in: Boss Arena (Room 28).
